mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 60 degrees near Fireman's Park under partly cloudy skies, though winds make it feel closer to 52 degrees.
The city news includes the latest weekly recap from the Verona Police Department, outlining preliminary details from recent officer investigations and calls for service.
You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Trivia is on tap for tomorrow, and Main Street Trick Or Treat is coming up on October 29th for local families.

In police news, on Saturday morning, officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle sitting in the intersection for 20 minutes, where a 40-year-old Verona man was found passed out and arrested for an O W I.
Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM today, serving up Pumpkin Pecan as their daily custard flavor.
